requirement.description: The normalize_path function in _url.py is not properly handling certain edge cases in path normalization, particularly with Unicode characters and complex path structures. Several test cases from test_normalize_path.py are failing due to incorrect handling of path segments with dots and double-dots.
requirement.contract: The normalize_path function should correctly process paths with Unicode characters, handle absolute paths properly, and correctly resolve "." and ".." segments according to RFC 3986 rules. It should preserve leading slashes for absolute paths and correctly handle trailing segments.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_normalize_path.py::test_normalize_path[μονοπάτι/../../να/𝕦𝕟𝕚/𝕔𝕠𝕕𝕖/.-να/𝕦𝕟𝕚/𝕔𝕠𝕕𝕖/] and similar Unicode path tests should pass

requirement.description: There are setup failures in several URL-related tests due to cache-related issues or environment problems. These tests are failing during the setup phase rather than execution, suggesting issues with test infrastructure or module initialization.
requirement.contract: All URL-related tests in test_url.py should be able to execute properly, including those involving cache population, URL building, and fragment handling. The tests should not fail during setup due to missing dependencies or incorrect initialization.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_url.py::test_relative_url_populates_cache, tests/test_url.py::test_with_suffix_keep_query_keep_fragment_flags[none], and similar setup-failing tests should pass

requirement.description: The _normalize_path_segments helper function needs to correctly handle the edge case where a path ends with "." or ".." segments, which should result in a trailing empty string to maintain proper path structure.
requirement.contract: The _normalize_path_segments function should properly handle paths ending with "." or ".." segments by appending an empty string to the result to preserve the trailing slash semantics for absolute paths.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_normalize_path.py::test_normalize_path[path/to/./.-path/to/] and related path tests should pass

requirement.description: Cache configuration and management functions are not properly initialized or accessible in some test contexts, causing setup failures for cache-related tests.
requirement.contract: The cache configuration functions (cache_clear, cache_configure, cache_info) should be properly exposed and functional in all test scenarios without setup failures.

requirement.description: The URL class's internal _normalize_path method is not correctly handling complex relative path resolution with multiple dots and slashes, particularly when dealing with absolute paths.
requirement.contract: The _normalize_path class method should correctly normalize paths according to RFC 3986 rules, preserving absolute path semantics and correctly processing dot segments.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_normalize_path.py::test_normalize_path[/foo/../../../ton-/ton] and similar absolute path tests should pass
